# Claim Gate test fixtures — TEST ONLY keys

Every `TEST_ONLY_key_*.pem` file in this directory is a **TEST ONLY** Ed25519
private key. They were generated by `scripts/generate_claim_goldens.py` solely
to sign the public `example.com` golden fixtures under `tests/golden-claims/`.

- They protect **nothing**. There is no system, account, or artifact outside
  this test suite that trusts them.
- Never reuse them for real bundles. Real issuers generate their own keys with
  `constitutional_cms.claims.generate_keypair` and keep them out of git.

`keys.json` is the corresponding public keys document in the
`/.well-known/constitutional-cms/keys.json` shape (see `docs/CLAIM_GATE.md`).
It deliberately contains `test-2026-a` (retired) and `test-2026-b` (active) —
the key-rotation constitution test — and deliberately omits `test-2026-c`,
which signs the unknown-key golden that must fail closed.
